clippings.speaker: Nora Ephron
clippings.quote: Well, Meg can do everything. Meg is both funny and smart, and you rarely get that in one person. She's a brilliantly gifted actress. She really is.
clippings.title: Nora Ephron | Academy of Achievement
clippings.context: Ephron, asked in her Academy of Achievement interview in Washington, D.C., why she kept casting Ryan.

clippings.speaker: Nora Ephron
clippings.quote: We had a read-through, and Billy Crystal and Meg Ryan read the script, and at the end of the read-through, Meg said, "You know, I think this scene would be much funnier if it took place in a restaurant," … and then Meg said, "And then I think at the end of the scene, she should have an orgasm,"
clippings.title: Nora Ephron | Academy of Achievement
clippings.context: Ephron explaining how Ryan reshaped the famous Katz's Deli scene at the read-through.

clippings.speaker: Nora Ephron
clippings.quote: And you know, you hear an idea like that, and you think, "I am so lucky to be working with these people." Thank God people believe in collaboration.
clippings.title: Nora Ephron | Academy of Achievement
clippings.context: Ephron's reaction to Ryan's (and Crystal's and Reiner's) ideas for the orgasm scene.

clippings.speaker: Meg Ryan
clippings.quote: She was very prepared. Her love of creating was contagious … The set felt like going to a great dinner party. You just didn't want to leave.
clippings.title: Meg Ryan Honors Late Rom-Com Legend Nora Ephron: 'So Many Blessings in My Life Because of Her' (Exclusive)
clippings.context: Ryan to People while promoting What Happens Later, which she dedicated to Ephron; two consecutive quoted sentences joined.

clippings.speaker: Meg Ryan
clippings.quote: Almost the whole time, I thought about her. I am so grateful to her in general. … This is a piece of work that says, "I was paying attention, lady, and thank you because my life is full of blessings."
clippings.title: Meg Ryan on Dedicating Her First Movie in Eight Years to Nora Ephron
clippings.context: Ryan on why What Happens Later ends with a dedication to Ephron.

clippings.speaker: Meg Ryan
clippings.quote: She had pure delight on a movie set, and now I understand that. I also understand she was tough, and she had a way of being in the world of Hollywood — very intellectual and stern — sometimes to get what she wanted.
clippings.title: Meg Ryan on what romance means to her — and why her new movie isn't really a rom-com
clippings.context: Ryan on All Things Considered, reflecting on Ephron after directing her own film.

clippings.speaker: Meg Ryan
clippings.quote: I think it shares some DNA with some of the movies Nora did. In her movies, she had a belief in kismet and destiny.
clippings.title: 'What Happens Later' co-stars Meg Ryan and David Duchovny talk about rom-coms, fame and Nora
clippings.context: Ryan in an AP joint interview with David Duchovny, on the airport voice in What Happens Later.

notes: Hollywood Reporter, Variety and Deadline (tollbit) and HuffPost blocked; Ephron-side quotes all from one 2007 interview, no open period interviews found.
